visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Counter Instead of a Dictionary and a Sort
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A dictionary is filled with an if / else and then sorted by count. Use Counter and most_common. The output must stay the same.

solution.code:
from collections import Counter

text = "the cat and the hat and the bat"
print(Counter(text.split()).most_common(2))
solution.explanation: Counter is made for counting: it handles the first occurrence of an item without a branch and sorts by frequency for you.
